// Package probe is a synthetic public API held still, so that what a tool
// reports about a change to it is a measurement of the tool.
package probe

import "lydite.example/probe/internal/store"

// Removed is dropped by the removed-function shape.
func Removed() {}

// Signature gains a parameter in the changed-signature shape.
func Signature(a int) error { return nil }

// Store is implemented outside this package, so a method added to it breaks
// every implementer while breaking nobody who only calls it.
type Store interface {
	Get(key string) (string, bool)
}

// Config is constructed by callers, by field name.
type Config struct {
	Timeout int64
	Name    string
}

// Cached reaches the internal package from the public surface, so that package
// is loaded without being part of the API.
func Cached(key string) string { return store.Get(key) }
